layout: All six contexts for each model; labels/forward/reverse/difference; unchanged primary masks, fixed scales 0..1 and -1..1; no crop selection or rerender.
limitations: Visual review supports descriptive interpretation only; no transcription, translation, physical-normal diagnosis or independent accuracy claim.

observations.native-paris1: Context1 loses much of its upper stroke contrast. Context2 reduces broad upper background responses, consistent with its ranking improvement, but still lacks a clear general recovery of the supplied lower strokes. This exception is retained without selecting its direction.
observations.native-paris2: All four contexts are retained. Reversal removes strong forward stroke contrast in frag1-context2 and markedly lowers scores in frag2-context2; frag2-context1 gains substantial broad off-stroke response. No panel supports treating reversal as a uniform correction.
observations.seed42-paris1: Both contexts lose responses on supplied strokes. In context1, the upper central stroke response falls while a region near the right stroke brightens; context2 loses lower stroke contrast and has increased upper-right background response.
observations.seed42-paris2: All four contexts are retained. Reversal suppresses the weak context1 stroke region, loses the tall stroke in frag1-context2, changes broad background patterns in frag2-context1, and suppresses much of frag2-context2.
